# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Commands

```bash
# Run all tests (report is auto-generated by serenity-cucumber)
./gradlew clean test

# Run tests for a specific tag
./gradlew clean test -Dcucumber.filter.tags="@login"

# Run tests for a specific feature file
./gradlew clean test -Dcucumber.features="src/test/resources/features/01_autenticacion/login.feature"

# Build only (no tests)
./gradlew build -x test
```

Available tags: `@autenticacion`, `@login`, `@transacciones`, `@metas`, `@dashboard`

The Serenity HTML report is generated at `build/site/serenity/index.html`.

## Prerequisites

- Java 17
- Chrome installed (WebDriverManager auto-downloads ChromeDriver)
- The MS Finanzas frontend running at `http://localhost:3000`

## Architecture

This project uses **Serenity BDD + Screenplay pattern** to test the MS Finanzas web application. It follows a strict layer separation:

### Layer structure

```
src/main/java/.../finanzas/
├── userinterfaces/   — Page Objects (Target locators only, no logic)
├── tasks/            — Screenplay Tasks (what an actor does)
├── questions/        — Screenplay Questions (what an actor observes)
├── models/           — Data builders (UserModel, TransactionModel, SavingGoalModel)
├── utils/            — Helpers (WaitTime wraps Pause.for_)
└── exceptions/       — FinanzasException (RuntimeException wrapper)

src/test/java/.../finanzas/
├── runners/          — Single JUnit Runner (CucumberWithSerenity)
└── stepdefinitions/  — Glue between Gherkin steps and Tasks/Questions

src/test/resources/
├── features/         — .feature files grouped by epic folder (01_, 02_, ...)
└── serenity.conf     — Browser config, base URLs, screenshot policy
```

### Key conventions

- **UserInterfaces** hold only `Target` constants (CSS/XPath locators). No methods, no waits.
- **Tasks** are instantiated via static factory methods (e.g., `Login.withCredentials(email, pw)`). They call `actor.attemptsTo(...)` internally.
- **Questions** return typed values and are checked with `actor.should(seeThat(..., is(...)))`.
- **Models** use the Builder pattern with a hand-rolled inner `Builder` class (no Lombok).
- **NavigateTo** reads `pages.*` URLs from `serenity.conf` via `SystemEnvironmentVariables`. Add new pages by extending the `Page` enum and adding a case to the switch.
- Each step-definition class calls `OnStage.setTheStage(new OnlineCast())` in a `@Before` hook to initialize the actor stage.
- `WaitTime.of(ms)` wraps `Pause.for_` — use this instead of `Thread.sleep`.

### Configuration

URLs and browser settings live in [src/test/resources/serenity.conf](src/test/resources/serenity.conf). The base URL defaults to `http://localhost:3000`. Screenshots are taken on failures only (`take.screenshots = FOR_FAILURES`).
